description: This Java file defines a custom validation annotation @PasswordStrengthCheck used for enforcing password strength requirements in the application. It specifies the annotation's properties, such as message, groups, payload, and a required value of type PasswordStrength. The annotation is linked to a validator class PasswordStrengthValidator.
